    • Snippet builder

    Snippet builder

    Fill in the form to get a ready-to-run Python script for scoring one variant. Nothing is sent anywhere — the code is generated in your browser. Your API key is never requested: the script reads ALPHA_GENOME_API_KEY from the environment (see §4).

    Coordinates

    The variant position is 1-based (copy POS straight from a VCF) and must be on hg38. Check that REF matches hg38 at that position. See §5.1.

    chr1–chr22, chrX, chrY
    Positive integer, VCF-style
    Letters A, C, G, T only
    Letters A, C, G, T only
    16 KB for fast exploration; 1 MB gives the best results (§5.2)
    Comma-separate several; leave empty for all tracks (§5.3)
    Scorers

    python
